_about: Public-domain E. M. Goulburn (Edward Meyrick Goulburn, 1818-1897, Head Master of Rugby, Dean of Norwich) for the Word Hoard: An Address to the Sisters of St. Peter's Home (1864) from Project Gutenberg, and 21 books from Internet Archive scans, 1850-1898, among them his Bampton Lectures on the Resurrection of the Body, Thoughts on Personal Religion, The Pursuit of Holiness, The Collects of the Day and Three Counsels of the Divine Master. Some multi-volume works have only one volume on IA. Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 23 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
